faqs.question: Does 🌦️😔 age well?
faqs.answer: 🌦️😔 ages well. The emotion-coded register is universal across generations; the combos that survive ten years on emoji keyboards usually carry feeling-coded weight.

faqs.question: What does 🌦️😔 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram 🌦️😔 punctuates soft-coded captions and stories. The emotion register shows up on life-event posts the sender wants marked with feeling.

faqs.question: Is 🌦️😔 an expression of gratitude?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. Emotion-coded pairs with the sparkle or heart partner can read as "thank you" without writing it out.

faqs.question: Can 🌦️😔 be romantic?
faqs.answer: 🌦️😔 can read romantic when sent by a partner. The emotion-coded cue tends to land tender-coded rather than flirty; the read depends on the relationship.
